speed_limit_note: Preview regularization, not a manufacturer-rated or dynamically feasible speed.
mapping: Initial-pose-anchored ankle displacement to wheel centers; one uniform scale from robot hip-knee-wheel chain length / human hip-knee-ankle chain length.
root: Prescribed scaled global pelvis translation and initial-pose-calibrated relative pelvis rotation; frozen inside each IK QP.
knees: Not human-knee tracking: TRON1 bends backward, unlike the human. Warm start plus a small neutral posture cost select the robot branch.
wheels: Spin frozen at zero. No human ankle orientation, rolling constraint, force, or dynamics imposed.
